abstract: We establish unconditional theorems on multi-probe Selberg-Mobius approximation in the Nyman-Beurling Hilbert space and supercritical truncated divisor sums. First (Theorem 1), for the codimension-2 neutral subspace $W_K$ of [1], we prove that the periodic quadratic wave $b_m(k)$ satisfies $b_m(k+1)-b_m(k)=-f_m(k)$ for all $k\ge 1$, admits an $m$-periodic cubic antiderivative $s_m(k)$, and has closed-form GCD correlation $R_{m,n}$ vanishing whenever $\gcd(m,n)=1$. Using Weighted Schur's Test and an ungrouped $(j,n)$ Zeta-$(3/2)$ Montgomery-Vaughan Hilbert inequality on the Farey set $\mathcal{F}_K$, we eliminate the Ramanujan divisor factor $(\log N)^{3/2}$ and prove $\|P_{W_K}((\log N)(1-g_N)-q)\|_{\mathcal{H}}\ll K^2(\log K)^{3/2}/N$ for all $4\le K\le N^{1/2}$, yielding unconditional second-order norm descent whenever $K^2(\log K)^{3/2}=o(N)$, i.e., $K=o(N^{1/2}(\log K)^{-3/4})$. Under the Loewner domination $R_K\preceq (\pi^2/96)^2\operatorname{diag}(m^2)$, the Sobolev-regularized probe $u_{\lambda_K}\in W_K$ extends second-order norm descent up to $K\le N^{1-\varepsilon}$ ($\lambda_K=K^{-1}$) and $4\le K\le N$ ($\lambda_K=(\log K)^{-1}$). In Propositions 1 and 2, we establish the second-order Gram expansion, the finite-$N$ Baez-Duarte extraction identity, the Mobius-dual basis $\tau_k$ Ramanujan harmonic-tail isometry, the Primitive Dedekind-Vasyunin factorization of $G_\tau$, the Mellin functional-equation flip identity, the Mertens-subtracted lower-triangular tail $\widetilde{R}_k(t)$, the $1/92$ prime-power obstruction, and the primorial Mertens-lag contrast. Second (Theorem 2), extending de la Breteche, Dress, and Tenenbaum [2] and Graham [3], we establish the unequal-cutoff covariance profile $\mathcal{D}_2(N/X_1,N/X_2)$ and Goldston-Yildirim mean-square error profile $\mathcal{L}_2(N/X_1)$ for $N^{1/2}<X_1\le X_2\le N$. These results do not bound the leading residual norm of $1-g_N$ or prove RH.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Version 4 incorporates all referee recommendations from the v3 review and resolves all issues identified in the review of yiZNauPXJrtXve3A (verified in explore_ungrouped_bernoulli2_gram_expansion.py and explore_euler_shell_schur_coercivity.py): (1) Range vs. convergence condition: Theorem 1(c), Section 1, and the shortened metadata abstract explicitly distinguish the range of validity 4 <= K <= N^{1/2} of the upper bound from the convergence condition K^2(log K)^{3/2} = o(N) (i.e. K = o(N^{1/2}(log K)^{-3/4})) required for second-order norm descent, and the duplicate abstract in paper40_manuscript.md has been removed. (2) Cubic antiderivative bound, summation-by-parts index, and constant term: In the proof of Proposition 1(c)-(d), we use the elementary uniform bound ||\tilde{s}_m||_\infty <= m^2/12 and retain the lower summation index r = k+1 in summation by parts so that the boundary denominator is k(k+1)(k+2) > k^3, giving |K_m(k) - b_m(k)/k^2| <= ||b_m||_\infty/(k^2(k+1)) + 4||\tilde{s}_m||_\infty/(k(k+1)(k+2)) <= (4m^2+m)/(12k^3); we also restore 1 + ... in 1 - g_\xi(j) and certify C_second = 1.314217 at truncation J = 10^6 with explicit tail bound <= 1.67e-7. (3) Consistent sign convention and exact residual decomposition in Proposition 2(c): We express all formulas directly in terms of d_k(\xi)/k (eliminating \tilde{d}_k), giving S_1(\xi) = 1 - \sum_{k=2}^N \mu(k)(d_k(\xi)/k), \widetilde{R}_k(t) := R_k(t) - R_k(0) + \mu(k)H_t = -\sum_{m=1}^t (c_k(m) - \mu(k))/m = -\sum_{d|k, d>=2}\mu(k/d)H_{\lfloor t/d \rfloor} (with \widetilde{R}_k(t) = 0 for 0 <= t < P^-(k) and \widetilde{R}_k(P^-(k)) = \mu(k) for \mu(k) != 0), and the exact harmonic-residual decomposition L_t(\xi) = 1 + (S_1(\xi) - 1)H_t + \sum_{k=2}^N \widetilde{R}_k(t)(d_k(\xi)/k) (verified in exact rational arithmetic across all t >= 1, including \xi = 0). (4) Exact primorial Mertens-lag identity in Proposition 2(d): At k = \prod_{p <= x} p and N = k x, M_1^{(k)}(x) = 1 and L_1^{(k)}(x) = 0 give d_k(\xi^{SM})/k = (\mu(k)/k)(1 - \log k / \log N) = (\mu(k)/k)(\log x / \log N), so the ratio to \mu(k)/(\varphi(k)\log N) equals (\varphi(k)/k)\log x -> e^{-\gamma} \approx 0.561459 != 1 (verified directly against the defining sum in explore_euler_shell_schur_coercivity.py). (5) Bibliographic attribution: We cite riemann_hypothesis_33/v1 [14] (with Theorem 3 cited for the 15/\pi^2 limit and Theorem 1 for the step-space Parseval identity), riemann_hypothesis_16/v2 [15], and Balazard [13] (arXiv:1812.04309).
title: Bernoulli-2 Farey Large-Sieve Neutral Descent and Supercritical Truncated Divisor Covariance
